secondaryIdInfos.domain: European Organisation for Research and Treatment of Cancer

identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of Pembrolizumab (MK-3475) Versus Placebo After Complete Resection of High-Risk Stage III Melanoma (MK-3475-054/1325-MG/KEYNOTE-054)
identificationModule.officialTitle: Adjuvant Immunotherapy With Anti-PD-1 Monoclonal Antibody Pembrolizumab (MK-3475) Versus Placebo After Complete Resection of High-risk Stage III Melanoma: A Randomized, Double- Blind Phase 3 Trial of the EORTC Melanoma Group

armGroups.label: Pembrolizumab
armGroups.description: In Part 1, participants receive pembrolizumab 200 mg intravenously (IV) as post-surgery therapy every 3 weeks (Q3W) for up to 1 year. During Part 2, participants with documented recurrence may receive optional re-treatment with pembrolizumab Q3W for up to 2 years or disease progression.

armGroups.label: Placebo
armGroups.description: In Part 1, participants receive placebo IV as post-surgery therapy Q3W. During Part 2, participants with documented recurrence who received placebo in Part 1 may receive optional treatment with pembrolizumab Q3W for up to 2 years or disease progression.

interventions.name: pembrolizumab
interventions.description: Pembrolizumab 200 mg administered intravenously (IV) on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle

interventions.name: placebo
interventions.description: Normal saline solution administered IV on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle
